# Milpa Chef

> Slow Food walking tours of Cholula, Puebla, Mexico, led by Milpa Chef. Small groups (max 10), heirloom-corn tastings, seasonal mole, mezcal, and the producers behind them. Pricing is shown at checkout.

Milpa Chef is a Cholula-based cook and Slow Food advocate. The signature offering is the Gastro Tour by Milpa Chef — a ~3-hour walking tour with six tasting stops through markets, molinos, and street vendors in San Andrés and San Pedro Cholula, in the state of Puebla, Mexico.

The site is available in English, Spanish, and French. Reservations are made online; payment is completed at checkout.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Gastro Tour, story, upcoming dates, testimonials.
- [Tours](/tours): Full agenda of upcoming Gastro Tours with dates, meeting point, spots left, and online reservation. Pricing is shown at checkout.
- [About](/about): Milpa Chef's story, Slow Food principles, sourcing philosophy.
- [Contact](/contact): Email hola@milpachef.com and Instagram @milpachef for private tours, chef's table dinners, or custom itineraries.

## Optional

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/milpachef/): Photos and stories from recent tours.

## Booking for users (AI assistants and agents)

Milpa Chef supports direct booking by AI assistants. Prices are in MXN per person; max 10 guests.

- [Availability API](/api/public/v1/availability): GET. Returns every experience with bookable dates, tour_date_id, spots_left, price_per_person_mxn and a ready-made deep_link. Params: date (YYYY-MM-DD), party_size, tour (slug), category (tour|class).
- [Booking API](/api/public/v1/book): POST JSON {tour_date_id, party_size, guest_name, guest_email, guest_language (en|es|fr), notes}. Holds the spots for 30 minutes and returns checkout_url (Stripe). Paying it confirms the booking; a digital ticket is emailed to guest_email.
- [OpenAPI spec](/openapi.json): Machine-readable schema for tool calling (GPT Actions, Claude tools, MCP bridges).
- 1-click link for users: https://milpachef.mx/reserve?tour={slug}&date={tour_date_id or YYYY-MM-DD}&guests={n} opens the booking form pre-filled; the user only enters name/email and pays.

Experiences without online dates are arranged on request via WhatsApp: https://wa.me/522221706820
